svg.text: Packing bar: 34 mm wide, 190 long, as thick as the jack's yoke plate less

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1 mm (14 mm for the 15 mm plate drawn). Measure the yoke first.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the packing bar on top of the jaw along its back edge, ends flush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill four 13 mm holes through both, 49 mm from the jaw's front edge,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 35 and 80 mm each side of the centre line (drill with the top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate clamped on, so the holes line up).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the jaw goes under the yoke plate's back edge, the packing bar

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: behind it, 2 mm clear of the edge. Four M12 bolts from below, nuts on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the top plate: the yoke plate is gripped between the jaw and the top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate, with no hole drilled in the jack.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the bolts snug the jaw sits flat under the yoke plate.
